claim_text: Recursive Self-Scouting (Cairn as Living Archive)**   Saw `docs/cairn/` bloated with 5000+ `scout_*`/`scour_*` files (e.g., `scout_5966_20260314_llama-3-8b-instruct.md`), each a "tensor" of model verdicts on claims like "lines 56–81 demonstrate portability" (often **DENIED** with line-by-line evidence).
